# `projectile`

A kind of projectile: a mass with a cross-section and a striking surface that flies as a body when something shoots (07 §11.1).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `mass` ([mass](../units.md#mass) in `kg`; **required**): Its mass.
- `area` (number, or `null`; optional): Its cross-section, in square metres. Left out, its surface's area.
- `drag` (number; optional): Its drag coefficient.
- `restitution` (number; optional): How much of its speed along the direction it struck in it keeps when it is turned back, from 0 to 1.
- `surface` (object [`ProjectileSurface`](#projectilesurface); **required**): What it strikes with.
- `leaves` (object [`LeavesDef`](#leavesdef), or `null`; optional): A field it leaves where it comes to an end.
- `on_impact` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): Effects run at the first thing it strikes, with `self` the one who fired it, `here` the cell and `target` the creature struck, if it was one. It ends there.
- `thrust` (object [`ThrustDef`](#thrustdef), or `null`; optional): A drive along its path.
- `guidance` (object [`GuidanceDef`](#guidancedef), or `null`; optional): How it steers. Read and carried.
- `fuse` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`, or `null`; optional): When it bursts on its own. Read and carried: a timed charge is thrown and timed by a rule's `after` (07 §11.5).
- `item` (id of a [`item`](item.md), or `null`; optional): What it is as an item once it is caught in flight (07 §11.6, `catch_shot`): an arrow caught is an arrow in the hand. Left out, a projectile caught is stopped and becomes nothing.

<a id="projectilesurface"></a>
### `ProjectileSurface`

What a projectile strikes with (07 §11.1, §3.2): a damage type, a contact area and a give, and a span across what it strikes.

- `kind` (id of a [`damage_type`](damage_type.md); **required**): The damage type it delivers.
- `area` (number; **required**): Contact area, in square metres.
- `give` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; **required**): The distance over which it is stopped.
- `span` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; optional): The length of contact across what it strikes: what decides whether it can sever. Default 0.

<a id="leavesdef"></a>
### `LeavesDef`

A field a projectile leaves where it comes to an end (07 §11.1): fire where an incendiary lands, smoke where a canister bursts.

- `field` (id of a [`field`](field.md); **required**): The field.
- `amount` (whole number; optional): How much of it is added, in levels from 1 to 255. Default 1.

<a id="thrustdef"></a>
### `ThrustDef`

Thrust along a projectile's path for a time (07 §11.1): the world's drive (02 §15).

- `accel` (number; **required**): The acceleration it gives along the path, in m/s².
- `burn` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`; **required**): How long it lasts.

<a id="guidancedef"></a>
### `GuidanceDef`

How a projectile steers (07 §11.1). Read and carried: guidance is not built.

- `by` (string; **required**): What it steers for: `point`, `seeker`, `launcher` or `return`.
- `sense` (string, or `null`; optional): For a seeker, the kind of signal it follows.
- `cone` (number, or `null`; optional): For a seeker, the cone it senses in, in degrees.
- `range` (number, or `null`; optional): For a seeker, how far it senses, in metres.
- `turn` (number; optional): How fast it turns, in radians a second.
